pairs.target: dìqī shítiān de xiǎo kèshì lǐ , duō le yíliàng tuīchē .
pairs.english: A cart had appeared in the small classroom on day seventy.
pairs.hanzi: 第七十天的小课室里，多了一辆推车。

pairs.target: lúnzǐ bú dà , chē bǎn shàng de jiù qī bèi mó chū jǐdào qiǎngōu . tā búshì gěi xuéshēng zuò de ,
pairs.english: Its wheels were small and shallow grooves scored the old paint on the bed. It was not for students to ride.
pairs.hanzi: 轮子不大，车板上的旧漆被磨出几道浅沟。它不是给学生坐的，

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ yídài gān shā fàngshàngqù , yòu zài liǎngbiān gè diàn yíkuài mùtou , miǎnde dàizǐ huá . sāntiān hòu de huòcāng cèliáng , yào xiān yòng tā liàn zěnyàng zuò jìlù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey loaded a dry-sand sack with wooden blocks on either side to prevent sliding. For the warehouse survey in three days, they would practise recording first.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把一袋干沙放上去，又在两边各垫一块木头，免得袋子滑。三天后的货仓测量，要先用它练怎样做记录。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi , mǐlā hé yīwén fēn zài yìzǔ . luò héng gēn lìng liǎnggè xuéshēng zài duìmiàn liáng lún jìng , liángwán hái bǎ chǐ zhuǎnguò lái zhòng kàn yícì .
pairs.english: Tavi, Mira and Iven formed one group. Opposite, Lohen measured wheel diameter with two others, then turned his ruler to check again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维、米拉和伊文分在一组。洛衡跟另两个学生在对面量轮径，量完还把尺转过来重看一次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhīdào tā búshì zài gùyì tiāomáobìng , biàn méiyǒu xiàng cóngqián nàyàng jí zhe bào zìjǐ de shù .
pairs.english: Tavi knew it was not deliberate fault-finding and did not hurry to announce his own number as before.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维知道他不是在故意挑毛病，便没有像从前那样急着报自己的数。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng lìng yǒu yígè xiǎo mùhé . hénèi duǎn dànpiàn de yìduān gùdìng zhe , lìngyìduān dài yì jié qiānbǐ , qīngqīng tiē zài zhǐtiáo shàng .
pairs.english: A small wooden box held a short spring strip, fixed at one end, its other end carrying a pencil lightly touching paper.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上另有一个小木盒。盒内短弹片的一端固定着，另一端带一截铅笔，轻轻贴在纸条上。

pairs.target: tuīchē diān dòng , bǐjiān biàn huì liúxià luàn xiàn . lǎoshī shuō tā zhǐnéng bāng tāmen bǐjiào tóngyàng tiáojiàn xià de biànhuà , bùnéng kànjiàn yídào shēnhén , jiù xuānbù shì nǎ kē dīngzi huài le .
pairs.english: Jolts left tangled lines. The teacher said it could compare changes under identical conditions, not name a faulty nail from one deep mark.
pairs.hanzi: 推车颠动，笔尖便会留下乱线。老师说它只能帮他们比较同样条件下的变化，不能看见一道深痕，就宣布是哪颗钉子坏了。

pairs.target: yīwén dūn zhe kàn le bàntiān , wèn néng bunéng bǎ zhǐtiáo dàihuíqù . mǐlā shuō tā xiànzài jiù kěyǐ chāo , zhǐ hái méi huà , bái de .
pairs.english: Iven crouched to study it and asked to take the paper home. Mira said he could copy it now: still blank.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蹲着看了半天，问能不能把纸条带回去。米拉说他现在就可以抄，纸还没画，白的。

pairs.target: tā xiào le yìshēng , shēnshǒu bǎ hézi fúzhèng . mǐlā zhǔzhāng fàngzài chētóu , lí xiān pèng ménkǎn de lúnzǐ jìn .
pairs.english: He laughed and straightened the box. Mira wanted it at the front, near the wheel that would hit the threshold first.
pairs.hanzi:
他笑了一声，伸手把盒子扶正。
米拉主张放在车头，离先碰门槛的轮子近。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng fàng chē bǎn zhōngyāng , nàlǐ bǐjiào bù róngyì bèi huò yāhuài . liǎng rén shuō zhe shuō zhe , mǐlā yǐjīng bǎ zìjǐ de diǎnhuà dào tú shàng , tǎ wéi dehuà què hái méi jiǎngwán .
pairs.english: Tavi preferred the middle, safer from cargo damage. Before he finished, Mira was marking her choice on the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想放车板中央，那里比较不容易被货压坏。两人说着说着，米拉已经把自己的点画到图上，塔维的话却还没讲完。

pairs.target: " xiān bié dìng . " tā shuō . tā tíngxià bǐ , wèn wèishénme . tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng shuō zìjǐ tuī guò gèng duōchóng dōngxī ,
pairs.english: “Don't decide yet,” he said. She stopped and asked why. He almost said he had pushed more heavy loads.
pairs.hanzi:
“先别定。”他说。
她停下笔，问为什么。塔维本来想说自己推过更多重东西，

pairs.target: huàdàozuǐbiān huànchéng le lìng yíjù : " huò zhuāngshànglái yǐhòu , nà kuài dìfāng hái kōng bu kōng ? " wéi lǎoshī bǎ yìzhī kōng kuāng fàngdào chēshàng , qiàhǎo dǎngzhù mǐlā huà de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Instead: “Once the cargo's loaded, will that space be free?” Instructor Vey placed an empty basket exactly over Mira's spot.
pairs.hanzi:
话到嘴边换成了另一句：“货装上来以后，那块地方还空不空？”
维老师把一只空筐放到车上，恰好挡住米拉画的位置。

pairs.target: mǐlā mǐn le mǐnzuǐ , bǎ nàge diǎn quānqǐlái , méi mǒdiào . " nà jiù táigāo . " tā shuō . " táigāo gēn fàng píng , huàng dé hái yíyàng ma ? " yīwén wèn .
pairs.english: Mira pressed her lips together and circled the spot without erasing it. “Raise it, then.” “Does it shake the same raised as flat?” Iven asked.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉抿了抿嘴，把那个点圈起来，没抹掉。
“那就抬高。”她说。
“抬高跟放平，晃得还一样吗？”伊文问。

pairs.target: zhèhuí sāngè rén dōu méi mǎshàng dá . lǎoshī méiyǒu tì tāmen xuǎn , zhī ràng tāmen xiān zài tóng yíliàng chēshàng shì liǎnggè wèizhì , qítā dōngxī búyào gēnzhe huàn .
pairs.english: None answered at once. The teacher did not choose for them; test both positions on the same cart while changing nothing else.
pairs.hanzi:
这回三个人都没马上答。
老师没有替他们选，只让他们先在同一辆车上试两个位置，其他东西不要跟着换。

pairs.target: dìshàng yǒu yìgēn gùdìng hǎo de ǎi mùtiáo , dàibiǎo ménkǎn ; tuīguòqù yǐhòu yào rào huílái , bùxǔ dǎo zhe chōng guò dìèrcì , miǎnde bǎshǒu dàngchéng shāchē .
pairs.english: A low fixed wooden strip represented the threshold. After crossing, circle around; no reversing into it and using hands as brakes.
pairs.hanzi: 地上有一根固定好的矮木条，代表门槛；推过去以后要绕回来，不许倒着冲过第二次，免得把手当成刹车。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuī dìyītàng , zǒu dé wěn , qiānbǐ zhī liúxià jǐdào duǎn hén . dìèrtàng tā xiǎng zǎoxiē tuī wán , kuài le jǐbù , mùhé lǐ xiǎng le yìshēng , zhǐ shàng nà tuán xiàn míngxiǎn cháng le .
pairs.english: Tavi pushed steadily on the first run, leaving only short marks. Hurrying the second, he quickened a few steps; the box rattled and the lines grew longer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维推第一趟，走得稳，铅笔只留下几道短痕。第二趟他想早些推完，快了几步，木盒里响了一声，纸上那团线明显长了。

pairs.target: mǐlā lìkè shuō , dìèrgè wèizhì bùxíng . tǎ wéi què méi sōngkāi chēbǎ . " zhècì shì wǒ tuī kuài le . "
pairs.english: Mira immediately rejected the second position. Tavi kept hold of the handles. “I pushed faster this time.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉立刻说，第二个位置不行。
塔维却没松开车把。
“这次是我推快了。”

pairs.target: tā táitóu kàn tā , yòu kàn zhǐ , zuìhòu zài pángbiān xiěxià bùsù bùtóng . nà zhāng kànqǐlái hěn yǒuyòng de zhǐ , zhǐhǎo liú zhe dāng bùnéng zhíjiē bǐ de nà yìzhāng .
pairs.english: She looked from him to the paper and noted differing pace. The useful-looking sheet became one that could not be compared directly.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬头看他，又看纸，最后在旁边写下步速不同。那张看起来很有用的纸，只好留着当不能直接比的那一张。

pairs.target: chóngxīn zuò shí , yīwén zhàn zài pángbiān shùbù , mǐlā dīng zhe lúnzǐ guò mùtiáo de wèizhì . tǎ wéi tīng zhe shēngyīn , yíbù yibù zǒu , dìyīcì juéde zǒu màn yě huì chūhàn , búshì lèi , shì zǒng xiǎng bǎ jiǎo luòde gēnshàng yíbù yíyàng .
pairs.english: On repeating, Iven counted steps and Mira watched the crossing point. Following the count, Tavi sweated with the effort of matching each step, not exertion.
pairs.hanzi: 重新做时，伊文站在旁边数步，米拉盯着轮子过木条的位置。塔维听着声音，一步一步走，第一次觉得走慢也会出汗，不是累，是总想把脚落得跟上一步一样。

pairs.target: liǎngzhāng xīn zhǐ chūlái , sān rén méiyǒu lìkè zhēng shuí duì . chētóu de hén gèng dà , zhōngyāng de hézi jiào wěn , dàn dōu háiyào děng zhēn huòwù bǎishàngqù , kàn gōngzuòrényuán yuànyì liú nǎ yìxiǎokuài dìfāng .
pairs.english: With two new records, nobody rushed to claim victory. Front marks were larger, the middle steadier; actual cargo and workers' available space still mattered.
pairs.hanzi: 两张新纸出来，三人没有立刻争谁对。车头的痕更大，中央的盒子较稳，但都还要等真货物摆上去，看工作人员愿意留哪一小块地方。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ liǎnggè diǎn dōu liúxià , xiě le gèzì de wèntí . xiūxi shí , tǎ wéi kànjiàn zìjǐ de yàngpiàn hé fàngzài chuāngtáishàng .
pairs.english: Mira kept both spots and their questions. Resting, Tavi saw his sample box on the sill.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉把两个点都留下，写了各自的问题。
休息时，塔维看见自己的样片盒放在窗台上。

pairs.target: cóng shàng huí shībài yǐhòu , tā yòu shàng guò sāncì xiǎo kè , qízhōng yícì liúxià le duǎnduǎn yíshùn , lìng liǎngcì méiyǒu . tā yuánxiān hěn xiǎng bǎ zhège bànfǎ yě dài qù huòcāng , hǎo ràng biérén zhīdào zìjǐ bù zhǐshì huì tuīchē .
pairs.english: Three more small-group lessons since his failure had yielded one brief residual hold and two failures. He had hoped to take that skill to the warehouse and be more than a cart-pusher.
pairs.hanzi: 从上回失败以后，他又上过三次小课，其中一次留下了短短一瞬，另两次没有。他原先很想把这个办法也带去货仓，好让别人知道自己不只是会推车。

pairs.target: tā wèn lǎoshī , néng bunéng zài cèshì shí gǎibiàn nà piàn jìlù yòng de gāngpiàn , ràng bǐ zǒu dé dà yìxiē . wéi lǎoshī ràng tā xiān shuō zěnyàng zhīdào , biàn dà de nà yíduàn láizì chē , háishì láizì tā .
pairs.english: He asked whether he could change the recording strip's response to make larger marks. Instructor Vey asked how he would distinguish the cart's effect from his own.
pairs.hanzi:
他问老师，能不能在测试时改变那片记录用的钢片，让笔走得大一些。
维老师让他先说怎样知道，变大的那一段来自车，还是来自他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe liǎngzhāng zhǐ , mànmàn bǎ wèntí xiǎng míngbái le . tāmen xiànzài lián bùzǐ kuài yìdiǎn dōu bùnéng hùn zhe bǐ , zìjǐ de nà yíxià gèng bùnéng tōutōu jiájìnqù .
pairs.english: Looking at the sheets, Tavi understood: they could not mix different walking speeds, much less his uncertain intervention.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着两张纸，慢慢把问题想明白了。他们现在连步子快一点都不能混着比，自己的那一下更不能偷偷夹进去。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà jiù xiān búyòng , lǎoshī diǎntóu , shuō yǐhòu kěyǐ dāndú zuò língmǐndù de kè , jīntiān xiān bǎ tóng yìzhǒng dōngxī bǐ qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: He would leave it out. She nodded: a separate sensitivity lesson later; compare the same thing today.
pairs.hanzi: 他说那就先不用，老师点头，说以后可以单独做灵敏度的课，今天先把同一种东西比清楚。

pairs.target: shōushí shí , yī wéncái bǎ zìjǐ yìzhí méishuōde shì tíchū lái . huòcāng shàngwǔ yǒu gùdìng de chūhuò shíchén , tāmen qù le , ruò zhènghǎo zhàn zhù mén , liáng dé zài hǎo yě tǎorénxián .
pairs.english: Packing up, Iven raised his concern: fixed morning departures at the warehouse. Blocking its doorway would annoy everyone, however good the measurements.
pairs.hanzi: 收拾时，伊文才把自己一直没说的事提出来。货仓上午有固定的出货时辰，他们去了，若正好占住门，量得再好也讨人嫌。

pairs.target: tā cóng ménfáng jièlái de shíkèbiǎo shàng zhǎochū kōngdàng , wèn néng bunéng bǎ yìzǔ xiān fàngdào cèmén wàimiàn děng . mǐlā kàn le kàn zìjǐ de tú , bǎ rén zhàn de wèizhì yě huà jìnqù .
pairs.english: From a gatekeeper's timetable he found a gap and proposed waiting outside a side door. Mira added standing places to her drawing.
pairs.hanzi:
他从门房借来的时刻表上找出空档，问能不能把一组先放到侧门外面等。
米拉看了看自己的图，把人站的位置也画进去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fāxiàn , yuánlái zhè zhāng zhǐ bù zhī gěi tuīchē liú lù , hái dé gěi tāmen zìjǐ liú lù . lín xiàkè , wéi lǎoshī xuānbù dìqīshísān tiān zǎofàn hòu chūfā , zǒu yǒurén wéihù de jiù dào , wǔhòu huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi saw the plan needed room for students as well as carts. Vey announced day seventy-three after-breakfast departure on a maintained old road, returning that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维发现，原来这张纸不只给推车留路，还得给他们自己留路。
临下课，维老师宣布第七十三天早饭后出发，走有人维护的旧道，午后回来。

pairs.target: liùgè xuéshēng , qìcái fēnkāi bèi , yǔ dà jiù gǎirì . tā ràng měizǔ bǎ fāngàn jiāo yífèn , yuángǎo zìjǐ liú zhe .
pairs.english: Six students, equipment shared, postponed for heavy rain. Each group submitted a copy and kept its draft.
pairs.hanzi: 六个学生，器材分开背，雨大就改日。她让每组把方案交一份，原稿自己留着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèi qǐ kōng mùhé shìleshì jiāndài . yīwén wèn tā qīng bu qīng , tā shuō qīng , xiànzài qīng .
pairs.english: Tavi tried the empty box's straps. Was it light, Iven asked. Light now, he said.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维背起空木盒试了试肩带。伊文问他轻不轻，他说轻，现在轻。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào zhe bǎ jìlùzhǐ fàngjìnqù , shuō nà jiù xiān tì dàjiā bèi dào ménkǒu . zhè yícì , tā méiyǒu bǎ suǒyǒu dōngxī dōu wǎng zìjǐ bāo lǐ sāi .
pairs.english: Mira laughed, put the recording sheets inside and asked him to carry it to the door. This time he did not stuff everything into his own bag.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉笑着把记录纸放进去，说那就先替大家背到门口。
这一次，他没有把所有东西都往自己包里塞。
